'''Escape at Cloud City''' was one of [[Leger DeMain]]'s most anticipated [[Holodrama/Legends|holofeatures]] in which he performed sleight-of-hand and great escapes. However, DeMain's luck run out during the escape and he required medical attention in the facilities on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].
